description: Run an ordered list of create / connect / setParam operations in one call (fail-forward, per-operation warnings; not transactional). Exposes the network builder as a general primitive — distinct from set_parameters_batch, which only sets parameters. Names created earlier can be referenced by later connect/setParam operations.

default_parent.description: Parent path for `create` operations that omit `parent_path`.

operations.description: Ordered list of create / connect / setParam operations. Runs in order, fail-forward: a failing operation becomes a warning and the rest still run (not transactional). Names created earlier can be referenced by later connect/setParam operations.

name.description: Optional name for the new node; later operations in this batch can reference it (TD may adjust it to avoid collisions).

parameters.description: Initial parameters to set on the new node, e.g. { period: 2, amplitude: 0.5 }.

parent_path.description: Parent to create this node inside; defaults to `default_parent`.

from.description: Source node — a name created earlier in this batch, or an absolute path (e.g. '/project1/noise1').

from_output.description: Output connector index on the source node (default 0).

to.description: Target node — a name created earlier in this batch, or an absolute path (e.g. '/project1/level1').

to_input.description: Input connector index on the target node (default 0).

parameters.description: Parameters to set on the node, e.g. { period: 2, amplitude: 0.5 }.

path.description: Node to update — a name created earlier in this batch, or an absolute path. Names are resolved to their created paths.

name: batch_operations
title: Batch operations
